strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not remove songs yet. First fetch release_year for every library song via the song-detail API, print song_id+year, then remove only songs before the required year.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Do not remove songs yet. Build songs_to_remove only after show_song (or equivalent detail API) confirms release_year. Print the candidate list with years, then remove only verified matches.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Abandon current removal. Re-plan: list library -> fetch release_year for each song -> filter by year threshold -> remove only matches -> re-list library to verify.

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Before deleting, call show_api_doc for Spotify song-detail and remove-from-library APIs. Confirm year fields and parameters, then continue carefully.
